Headline: Closure - La Sainte Union Catholic Secondary School (State), London
Info: Camden Council has launched a public consultation regarding the potential closure of four faith schools, including La Sainte Union, driven by falling pupil numbers, housing pressures, and financial difficulties.

Headline: Restructuring - Cheltenham College, Gloucestershire
Info: Cheltenham College has announced a major overhaul of its boarding options, introducing five new day and boarding pathways from September 2027 to offer greater choice and flexibility to modern families.
